prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
 No named child cast: Kit and Zoe MUST NOT appear. Include unnamed human workers/adults ONLY when explicitly required by this particular scene; otherwise show only the natural subjects. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Different Countries, Different Places; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: Factual geographic tour of selected ordinary landscapes in Japan, Egypt and Brazil. No fictional child travels between pages; no suggestion that one climate, building or landscape represents all people in a country. Maps are simplified geographic aids, not political claims; show whole-country approximate outlines with no disputed detail, capitals, flags, national costumes, religious monuments or political buildings. Japan: island coastline, Mount Fuji lower wooded slopes, ordinary Tokyo railway street. Egypt: dry plateau and connected Nile-side irrigated farmland with ordinary homes. Brazil: Amazon waterway with rainforest and ordinary Rio coastline framed by forested hills; omit Christ statue. Small background adults wear ordinary contemporary clothing and are never cultural symbols.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Simplified world locator map with dots for Japan, Egypt and Brazil; Japan island coastline, wooded Mount Fuji slopes, ordinary Tokyo train; Egypt desert and Nile river fields; Brazil Amazon waterway and Rio coastal city
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Opening locates three selected countries; no travel time or universal-country claim.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Simple world locator map, north up, with geographically correct continental silhouettes. Three dots only: Japan in east Asia, Egypt in northeast Africa, Brazil in eastern South America. Each dot has one leader line to a plain empty circular focus marker, no country names, political borders or invented land. Do not show Antarctica as an inhabited country.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions. Reference-sheet override: any lettering requested by the opening page brief belongs only in that finished page. Keep this production reference board entirely unlabelled; no letters, numbers or pseudo-writing.

visualReview.note: Geographic/style reference; extraneous wildlife and house types are production-only and excluded from all final reader scenes. Final maps and depicted geography were reviewed independently. Producer independently inspected the final installed WebP natively; complete final sequence and relevant native diagrams were independently reviewed.
